answer: To resist Sybils, an agent economy deploys game-theoretic multi-agent auditing using topological cut verifications. Because Sybil clusters must bridge back through a sparse cut of genuine nodes, independent auditors easily isolate them. Auditors slash the collateral stake of fraudulent identities, ensuring superlinear attacker cost: an adversary cannot forge valid credit without burning exponential resources. Like a sturdy juniper anchoring rocky soil against an encroaching weed vine, topological cuts starve fake subnetworks of economic bandwidth.
